title: talking-avatar camera track v1
description: One camera object, written inline on one moment (including ~variant ids). See docs/camera-track-contract.md. Status: locked 2026-11-07.

x.description: Crop center x as a fraction of the still width (anchor.json convention).

y.description: Crop center y as a fraction of the still height.

w.description: Crop width as a fraction of the still width. Must keep the crop inside the still.

h.description: Crop height as a fraction of the still height. Must keep the crop inside the still.

start.description: Seconds on the moment clock (R2), counted after any opening. >= 0.

end.description: Seconds, >= start. Cues must not overlap.

ease.description: Interpolation from `from` to `to` (R3). Omit when from equals to (a hold).

still.description: Path to the shipped still, relative to the consumer stills root (Bloodtower: the pack assets/). No absolute paths, no `..`. Naming this still is how a moment overrides the scene default.

standeeOff.description: When true, character standees are off for this moment. Default false. Used by .lid-choice and .08.

opening.description: Prelude before cue 0: 1.5 s full-width hold with 2.39:1 black bars, then a 1 s push to cues[0].from (R4). Skipped under reduced motion.

cues.description: Ordered camera moves. Empty means a static still; standeeOff and opening still apply.
